description: Design system token enforcement rules — consumed by design-check.sh and check-design-tokens.sh

rules.label: Background colors
rules.description: Use semantic background tokens: bg-primary (blue), bg-success (emerald), bg-warning (amber), bg-danger (red), bg-neutral (gray). See tailwind.config.js for full mapping.

rules.label: Text colors
rules.description: Use semantic text tokens: text-primary, text-success, text-warning, text-danger, text-neutral. Only text-white is allowed for contrast on colored backgrounds.

rules.label: Border colors
rules.description: Use semantic border tokens: border-primary, border-success, border-warning, border-danger, border-neutral. See tailwind.config.js for mappings.

rules.label: Ring colors
rules.description: Use ring-primary for focus rings (focus:ring-primary). Avoid raw ring color tokens.

rules.label: Divide colors
rules.description: Use divide-neutral for dividers instead of raw divide color tokens.

rules.label: Placeholder colors
rules.description: Use placeholder-neutral for input placeholders instead of raw placeholder color tokens.

rules.label: Shadow sizes
rules.description: Use shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg from design tokens. Prefer <Card> component which applies shadows automatically.

rules.label: Font weights (use CSS variables)
rules.description: Use CSS custom properties or semantic typography tokens. Prefer font-normal, font-medium, font-semibold, font-bold (allowlisted).

rules.label: Responsive prefixes (consider tokenization)
rules.description: Informational: responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:, 2xl:) are tracked for migration to token-based responsive utilities.
